topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder considering AthenaHQ cannot tell what it does, what its credit-based pricing really costs once usage grows, whether a free option exists, and whether they are the right buyer.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits whether AI engines name a brand; this guide helps a reader decide whether metered, ongoing GEO monitoring such as AthenaHQ is worth buying or whether a one-off audit answers the question first.

assessment: The page gives the reader AthenaHQ's current plans (Free, Starter, Enterprise) as published on its own pricing page on 2026-10-03, a worked monthly credit table with overage priced explicitly at an implied rate, a clear who-it-fits and who-should-skip split, and a neutral fact box from AEOeye's crawler study. It rests on AthenaHQ's own public pages, the GEO arXiv paper and Wikipedia's GEO definition. It deliberately does not claim hands-on testing, does not publish an extra-credit price (AthenaHQ does not), does not repeat the older no-free-tier and 95-dollar-first-month claims, and labels customer results as vendor-reported.

pricing.billing: Free plan; Starter $295 per month (annual toggle labeled 17% off, resulting price not confirmed); Enterprise custom; extra credits and API are paid add-ons with unpublished prices
pricing.verification: Fetched athenahq.ai/pricing with WebFetch and curl on 2026-10-03 and read the raw HTML: Free $25 free credit with tooltip 300 credits, Starter $295/month with 3,600 credits tooltip and $300/month free credit label, add-on pricing 'Contact us'. Recomputed $295/3,600 = $0.082 per credit, $300/3,600 = $0.083, and the four monthly scenarios (800; 3,200; 4,400; 33,000 credits) with overage at $0.0833.

sources.supports: Free plan ($25 free credit, 300 credits, five platforms), Starter $295/month with 3,600 credits and 11 models, Enterprise custom, 1 credit = 1 AI response, API and extra credits as paid add-ons with contact-us pricing, annual toggle labeled 17% off, Starter best for Self-Guided SMBs.
Homepage FAQ: Ask Athena copilot, platforms included on all plans versus paid plans, GA4, Search Console, Shopify, Webflow and Framer integrations, Grüns share-of-voice figure (vendor-reported).
Calculator estimates monthly credits across prompts, locations, models and cadence; 1 credit = 1 AI response; the page text does not explain the calculation.
Section 8: paid subscriptions auto-renew until canceled, payments non-refundable except as required by law or offered, trial terms shown before enrollment.

Monitor, understand, act structure: visibility and citations, prompt and demand intelligence, source intelligence, brand integrity and crawlability, content creation, citation outreach, commerce optimization.
17 integrations including GA4, Search Console, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Looker Studio, weekly Slack reports and MCP connections for ChatGPT and Claude.
Aggarwal et al., GEO: Generative Engine Optimization; abstract reports visibility boosts of up to 40% in generative engine responses.
Definition of generative engine optimization as improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
